transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Last spring I was in Shanghai for a bit and ended up chatting with locals about what shows were even popular there at the time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later on, when I was back in Beijing, my cousin kept talking about how their group always picked places around the city for big lunches.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I still remember my friend saying they went to the Mayday Concert, and they only got 1 ticket because everyone else already had theirs.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: They joked the seat was nothing fancy—Stand B—and the ticket was under Liu Yang, with that same phone number 13892862812.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And for food, my coworker once told me they had a big get-together at Shu Xiang Yuan on 2025-03-02.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: They said it was at 14:00 for 5 people, and the contact name on it was Feng Jie.
